research-appliance-buy.label: 高价家电/数码避坑横评
research-appliance-buy.description: 多源核查参数、真实差评与 3 年耗材总账
research-appliance-buy.prompt: 请深度调研 2026 年 3000–5000 元主流旗舰扫地机器人（石头、追觅、科沃斯、云鲸），输出参数对比表、长期真实差评汇总、3 年耗材总成本及按户型推荐结论，附来源角标。

research-ev-compare.label: 新能源车选购与 5 年账单
research-ev-compare.description: 实测续航、智驾口碑、保费与残值对比
research-ev-compare.prompt: 请深度对比 20–25 万热门家庭新能源 SUV（Model Y、极氪 7X、小鹏 G6、理想 L6）的冬季实测续航、辅助驾驶口碑与 5 年持有总成本，给出清晰试驾排序。

research-company-interview.label: 目标公司与面试前深度尽调
research-company-interview.description: 最新财报/业务、竞品格局与高分反问清单
research-company-interview.prompt: 请做一份目标公司面试前深度尽调报告，梳理近 1 年核心业务进展、主要竞品对比、业务挑战，并给出 6 个高频追问与 4 个高分反问问题。

research-travel-guide.label: 长假自由行深度避坑攻略
research-travel-guide.description: 交通精算、网红口碑核验与雨天备选
research-travel-guide.prompt: 请调研日本关西（大阪+京都+奈良）7 天自由行深度攻略：住宿片区对比、交通卡精算、每日顺路动线、提前预约避雷及 2 套雨天备选方案。

ppt-tpl-mckinsey.label: 极简咨询风 · 麦肯锡蓝白
ppt-tpl-mckinsey.description: 结论标题 + 双栏逻辑图表（10 页模板）
ppt-tpl-mckinsey.prompt: 采用极简咨询风（深海蓝+纯白、顶部一句话结论标题、双栏结构化图表）制作一份 10 页《2026 现制咖啡与茶饮消费趋势洞察》可编辑 PPT（标注演示示例数据）。

ppt-tpl-emerald-kpi.label: 清爽数据看板 · 商务翠绿
ppt-tpl-emerald-kpi.description: 大数字指标卡 + 复盘进度表
ppt-tpl-emerald-kpi.prompt: 采用清爽数据看板风（白灰底+翠绿/琥珀状态色）制作一份 10 页《Q3 业务复盘与 Q4 规划》可编辑汇报 PPT（标注示例数据），包含 KPI 卡片与里程碑状态表。

ppt-tpl-dark-keynote.label: 深色科技发布 · 极光黑金
ppt-tpl-dark-keynote.description: 发布会大片感 + 大字金句屏
ppt-tpl-dark-keynote.prompt: 采用深色科技发布会风（深邃石墨黑+极光高光）制作一份 12 页智能硬件新品发布宣讲 PPT（示例产品），涵盖痛点开场、3 大突破与版本对比。

ppt-tpl-warm-editorial.label: 暖调杂志叙事 · 莫兰迪米白
ppt-tpl-warm-editorial.description: 高级留白 + 年度成长时间轴
ppt-tpl-warm-editorial.prompt: 采用暖调杂志叙事风（暖米白+深青+低饱和暖橙）制作一份 8 页《2026 年度个人述职与成长复盘》可编辑 PPT（示例案例）。

data-personal-bill.label: 个人/家庭账单体检
data-personal-bill.description: 消费分类占比 + 隐形自动续费预警
data-personal-bill.prompt: 请使用一组 4 个月个人脱敏消费明细（标注模拟数据）示范个人账单体检：统计各类支出占比、识别自动续费隐形开销，输出带公式 Excel 与可视化看板。

data-store-sales.label: 门店/电商销售与爆品复盘
data-store-sales.description: 时段热力 + 爆品与滞销品毛利矩阵
data-store-sales.prompt: 请基于一组模拟咖啡轻食门店跨时段订单数据（标注示例数据），计算各 SKU 销量与毛利率，找出前 3 爆品与滞销品，输出带图表 Excel 与经营建议。

data-multi-merge.label: 多份杂乱表格自动合并对账
data-multi-merge.description: 不同表头对齐、去重与来源标记
data-multi-merge.prompt: 请演示将两份列名不统一的月度报销示例表（标注示例数据）智能对齐合并、标红疑似重复提交，并生成带 SUMIF 汇总公式的规范 Excel。

data-decision-matrix.label: 租房/买车加权比价打分
data-decision-matrix.description: 按通勤/价格/采光权重自动量化排行
data-decision-matrix.prompt: 请建立一套 6 套备选租房房源（标注示例数据）的加权比价模型（通勤 35%、租金 30%、采光 20%、面积 15%），输出可调权重公式 Excel 与推荐结论。

doc-meeting-minutes.label: 杂乱会议记录 → 规范纪要
doc-meeting-minutes.description: 结论前置 + 负责人/DDL 彩色待办表
doc-meeting-minutes.prompt: 请示范将一段口语化产品改版评审记录（标注示例素材）整理为排版精致的可编辑 Word 会议纪要，包含拍板结论、Owner+DDL 待办表与升级风险提示。

doc-contract-review.label: 租房/合作合同风险体检
doc-contract-review.description: 标红霸王条款 + 给出平等修改措辞
doc-contract-review.prompt: 请以租客立场审阅一份常见脱敏租房合同示例，按高/中风险标出押金、维修与违约陷阱条款，给出平等替代措辞与沟通话术，交付 Word 审阅稿。

doc-weekly-report.label: 碎片流水账 → 亮点周报
doc-weekly-report.description: 把“干了啥”升级成“拿了啥结果”
doc-weekly-report.prompt: 请把一组零散职场工作流水账（标注示例素材）重构成结果导向的精排周报 Word 文档，按成果、效率提升、卡点诉求与下周优先级呈现。

doc-resume-polish.label: 简历诊断与岗位定制改写
doc-resume-polish.description: STAR 法则升级 + JD 关键词对齐
doc-resume-polish.prompt: 请示范将一份普通运营简历与增长运营经理 JD 对照诊断，按 STAR 法则重写精排一页纸 Word 简历（需用户补填真实数据处用占位提示，绝不编造）。

web-interactive-resume.label: 互动在线简历 & 作品集
web-interactive-resume.description: 杂志感布局、项目筛选与打印友好样式
web-interactive-resume.prompt: 请制作一个杂志极简风单页互动个人简历与作品集 HTML 网页（含一键复制邮箱、按标签筛选项目并展开案例详情、打印友好样式）。

web-family-trip.label: 可交互家庭旅行攻略页
web-family-trip.description: 每日动线、实时算账与打包勾选清单
web-family-trip.prompt: 请制作一个手机端友好的《成都 4 天松弛美食游》可交互攻略 HTML 网页，含每日行程切换、实时人均预算计算器与本地保存勾选进度的打包清单。

web-life-calculator.label: 互动生活计算器（房贷/攒钱）
web-life-calculator.description: 滑块实时重算省息对比与可视化曲线
web-life-calculator.prompt: 请制作一个清爽的单页「房贷月供与提前还贷省息对比计算器」HTML 应用，支持滑块实时重算等额本息/本金、缩短年限 vs 减少月供对比与曲线图。

web-event-invite.label: 婚礼/年会高仪式感电子请柬
web-event-invite.description: 实时倒计时、流程轴与在线回执凭证
web-event-invite.prompt: 请制作一个手机优先的高仪式感电子邀请函 HTML 网页（深蓝星空与香槟金），含实时倒计时、流程时间轴、着装色卡与提交后生成电子入场券的 RSVP 表单。

research-appliance-buy.label: Smart Appliance Buying Guide
research-appliance-buy.description: Specs, real owner complaints & 3-year consumable costs
research-appliance-buy.prompt: Run a deep multi-source comparison of 2026 flagship robot vacuums ($500-$900) covering specs, long-term owner complaints, 3-year consumable costs, and household picks with inline citations.

research-ev-compare.label: EV & SUV 5-Year Comparison
research-ev-compare.description: Real winter range, ADAS reliability & 5-yr TCO
research-ev-compare.prompt: Compare popular $35k-$48k family electric SUVs on real-world winter range, charging speed, ADAS feedback, and 5-year total cost of ownership with a test-drive shortlist.

research-company-interview.label: Company & Interview Due Diligence
research-company-interview.prompt: Prepare a pre-interview due diligence dossier covering recent financials/launches, top 3 competitors, key product risks, 6 likely interview questions, and 4 sharp questions to ask.

research-travel-guide.label: Deep Travel & Pitfall Planner
research-travel-guide.description: Transit pass math, verified food picks & Plan B
research-travel-guide.prompt: Research a 7-day Kyoto, Osaka & Nara trip for 2 adults with stay-area comparisons, transit pass math, low-backtrack routing, reservation lead times, and rainy-day alternatives.

ppt-tpl-mckinsey.label: Consulting Blue & White
ppt-tpl-mckinsey.description: Executive action titles & clean two-column charts
ppt-tpl-mckinsey.prompt: Create a 10-slide Consulting Blue & White presentation (labelled sample data) on 2026 Specialty Coffee & Tea Trends with executive action titles and clean comparison visuals.

ppt-tpl-emerald-kpi.label: Clean KPI Dashboard
ppt-tpl-emerald-kpi.prompt: Create a 10-slide Clean KPI Dashboard deck (labelled sample data) for a Q3 Business Review & Q4 Plan with KPI hero cards and RAG milestone tracking.

ppt-tpl-dark-keynote.label: Dark Keynote Launch
ppt-tpl-dark-keynote.description: Stage-ready obsidian slides & bold hero stats
ppt-tpl-dark-keynote.prompt: Create a 12-slide Dark Keynote Launch deck for a sample 2026 AI Desk Companion covering status-quo pain, 3 breakthroughs, and clear tier comparisons.

ppt-tpl-warm-editorial.label: Warm Editorial Narrative
ppt-tpl-warm-editorial.prompt: Create an 8-slide Warm Editorial Narrative deck (sample case) for a 2026 Annual Career Review with timeline milestones and impact deep dives.

data-personal-bill.label: Personal Spending Health Check
data-personal-bill.prompt: Demonstrate a personal spending audit using a 4-month sample dataset (labelled sample): categorize spend, flag unused recurring subscriptions, and output an Excel workbook + visual dashboard.

data-store-sales.label: Store & E-Commerce Sales Review
data-store-sales.prompt: Analyze a sample cafe order dataset (labelled sample) to rank SKU margins, compare dayparts, and recommend menu & staffing moves with charts and Excel formulas.

data-multi-merge.label: Multi-Sheet Merge & Deduplicate
data-multi-merge.prompt: Demonstrate merging two sample monthly expense sheets with inconsistent headers (labelled sample), flagging suspected duplicates, and building a formula summary tab.

data-decision-matrix.label: Weighted Rent / Purchase Scorer
data-decision-matrix.description: Rank shortlisted options by custom weights
data-decision-matrix.prompt: Build a weighted scoring workbook for 6 sample apartment listings (Commute 35%, Rent 30%, Light 20%, Area 15%) with editable weight formulas and a clear top-2 ranking.

doc-meeting-minutes.label: Messy Notes → Actionable Minutes
doc-meeting-minutes.prompt: Turn a sample raw product-review transcript (labelled sample) into polished Word meeting minutes with decisions, owner/deadline table, and escalation risks.

doc-contract-review.label: Lease & Contract Risk Audit
doc-contract-review.description: Flag unfair clauses & polite redline wording
doc-contract-review.prompt: Audit a sample residential lease from the tenant's perspective, flagging high-risk clauses on deposits, repairs, and termination with balanced redline replacements in Word.

doc-weekly-report.label: Work Bullets → Impact Weekly
doc-weekly-report.description: Reframe rough chores into measurable outcomes
doc-weekly-report.prompt: Rewrite a sample list of casual weekly notes (labelled sample) into a crisp, outcome-focused weekly report Word document with clear blockers and asks.

doc-resume-polish.label: Resume Diagnosis & JD Tailoring
doc-resume-polish.prompt: Audit a sample resume against a Growth Manager JD and produce a clean 1-page Word resume using STAR framing without inventing metrics (use clear placeholders where needed).

web-interactive-resume.label: Editorial Portfolio & Resume
web-interactive-resume.prompt: Build an editorial minimal interactive resume & portfolio HTML page with copy-email button, filterable expandable case studies, career timeline, and print-ready styles.

web-family-trip.label: Interactive Trip Itinerary & Budget
web-family-trip.description: Day tabs, live budget math & packing checklist
web-family-trip.prompt: Build a mobile-first 4-day Kyoto trip planner HTML page with interactive day tabs, live per-person budget calculator, and a localStorage packing checklist.

web-life-calculator.label: Mortgage & Savings Simulator
web-life-calculator.prompt: Build a clean interactive Mortgage & Extra-Payment Savings Calculator HTML app with live sliders, interest-saved comparison cards, and an interactive payoff chart.

web-event-invite.label: Ceremony Event Invitation
web-event-invite.description: Live countdown, schedule & digital RSVP pass
web-event-invite.prompt: Build a mobile-first Starlight Gala invitation HTML page with a live countdown, timeline, dress palette, directions, and an interactive RSVP generating a digital pass.
